subject.title: fix(ui): hide the terminal dock while Settings is open

question: Should this protected Control UI behavior change be accepted after a current-main refresh, with Settings suppressing both docks non-persistently while explicit user opens remain allowed?
rationale: The implementation changes shared dock lifecycle behavior and the item carries the protected `maintainer` label; the supplied evidence supports the direction, but acceptance of the precise user-interaction contract belongs to a human owner.

options.title: Accept after refresh
options.body: Rebase onto current main and confirm the focused terminal/browser takeover tests and real-gateway scenario still pass.

options.title: Narrow the interaction contract
options.body: Keep Settings suppression but change the explicit-open behavior only if the Control UI owner prefers a stricter full-page takeover.

recommendation.title: Accept after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main and confirm the focused terminal/browser takeover tests and real-gateway scenario still pass.
